$comment: The three public projects featured on the profile. Descriptions and figures are drawn from each repository's own README and GitHub metadata as of 2026-11-09. Internal notes that must not be published live in docs/CONTENT_SOURCES.md, not here.

featured.name: NosoGraph
featured.summary: Connects disease knowledge to the evidence behind it. Every claim carries its source, its direction and its certainty — and missing metadata stays unknown instead of quietly becoming a guess.

featured.name: Agent-Ready
featured.summary: One schema-validated file that tells every AI coding agent how to work in a repository — the commands, the restrictions, the verification steps, and the evidence that the work is done.

featured.name: Short Squeeze Screener
featured.summary: A research screener that ranks short-squeeze candidates from structured market data, with data-quality checks at every step and a frozen demo mode for reproducible runs.
